name: max_sync_workers_per_subscription
description: Maximum number of parallel table synchronization workers launched per logical replication subscription during initial data copy or when adding new tables.
symptoms: Underutilized CPU during large table sync
Subscription lag due to serial table processing
tuning_tips: Increase to improve parallelism during initial sync of many tables; ensure total background workers (logical + sync + others) do not exceed max_worker_processes. Each worker handles one table, so set no higher than the typical number of new/changed tables per sync batch.
